bottom_line: First DSA enforcement actions by the European Commission set precedent for platform obligations; non-EU platforms with EU users must comply.
what_changed: European Commission opened formal proceedings against major platforms for alleged non-compliance with DSA transparency and risk-assessment obligations.
why_it_matters: Platforms face fines up to 6% of global turnover; compliance teams need operational processes for risk assessments and content moderation transparency.
main_uncertainty: Outcome of proceedings will define the practical enforcement standard; appeal timeline may delay precedent effect.

scenarios.name: Precedent-setting fine
scenarios.description: Commission issues substantial fine, clarifying compliance bar.

scenarios.name: Negotiated compliance
scenarios.description: Platform agrees to remedial measures without fine.
